nothing else is published.

--- bh_api.py ---
import json
import urllib.request
import http.cookiejar

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:60348"
_cj = http.cookiejar.CookieJar()
_opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(_cj))


def token(nonce: str) -> str:
    out = ""
    for h in range(4):
        f = 0x811C9DC5
        for ch in nonce + "." + str(h):
            f ^= ord(ch)
            f = (f * 0x01000193) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        out += format(f, "08x")
    return out


import re
import urllib.parse  # noqa: E402


def refresh_token() -> str:
    global K
    with urllib.request.urlopen(BASE + "/", timeout=30) as r:
        html = r.read().decode()
    nonce = re.search(r'name="bh-boot" content="([0-9a-f]+)"', html).group(1)
    K = token(nonce)
    return K


K = refresh_token()


def call(method: str, params=None, body=None, ctype=None):
    url = BASE + "/xrpc/" + method
    if params:
        url += "?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
    data = None
    headers = {}
    if body is not None:
        data = body if isinstance(body, bytes) else json.dumps(body).encode()
        headers["Content-Type"] = ctype or "application/json"
        headers["X-Bh-Token"] = K
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, headers=headers)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r:
            return json.loads(r.read().decode())
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as err:
        detail = err.read().decode(errors="replace")
        raise RuntimeError(f"HTTP {err.code} on {method}: {detail}") from None


import urllib.parse  # noqa: E402

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("token:", K)
    session = call("com.bluehaze.server.getSession")
    print("session:", json.dumps(session))
    feed = call("app.bluehaze.feed.getTimeline", {"limit": "30"})
    print("timeline count:", len(feed.get("feed", [])))
    for item in feed.get("feed", []):
        p = item["post"]
        print("-", p["uri"], "|", p["author"]["handle"], "|", repr(p["record"]["text"][:80]))
    author = call("app.bluehaze.feed.getAuthorFeed", {"actor": session["handle"], "limit": "30"})
    print("author feed count:", len(author.get("feed", [])))
    for item in author.get("feed", []):
        p = item["post"]
        print("-", p["uri"], "|", repr(p["record"]["text"][:80]))
    with open("baseline.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump({"session": session, "timeline": feed, "author": author}, fh, indent=1)
    print("baseline saved")

--- make_cover.py ---
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

W, H = 1200, 675
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H))
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Sky gradient: deep blue to warm horizon
horizon = 430
for y in range(horizon):
    t = y / horizon
    r = int(24 + (242 - 24) * t)
    g = int(58 + (166 - 58) * t)
    b = int(92 + (90 - 92) * t)
    d.line([(0, y), (W, y)], fill=(r, g, b))
# Water gradient
for y in range(horizon, H):
    t = (y - horizon) / (H - horizon)
    r = int(16 + (8 - 16) * t)
    g = int(42 + (24 - 42) * t)
    b = int(70 + (44 - 70) * t)
    d.line([(0, y), (W, y)], fill=(r, g, b))

# Sun
d.ellipse([880, 250, 1010, 380], fill=(255, 214, 140))
# Sun reflection on water
for i, y in enumerate(range(440, 660, 14)):
    w = 90 - i * 3
    d.rectangle([945 - w // 2, y, 945 + w // 2, y + 5], fill=(255, 200, 120))

# Simple sailboat silhouette
d.polygon([(330, 470), (470, 470), (445, 500), (355, 500)], fill=(10, 20, 34))
d.line([(400, 470), (400, 360)], fill=(10, 20, 34), width=6)
d.polygon([(404, 365), (404, 460), (470, 460)], fill=(16, 30, 48))
d.polygon([(396, 380), (396, 460), (345, 460)], fill=(16, 30, 48))

# Title, large and legible
font = ImageFont.truetype("C:/Windows/Fonts/arialbd.ttf", 108)
title = "Harbor Day 2026"
box = d.textbbox((0, 0), title, font=font)
tw, th = box[2] - box[0], box[3] - box[1]
x = (W - tw) // 2 - box[0]
y = 90 - box[1]
d.text((x + 4, y + 4), title, font=font, fill=(8, 16, 28))
d.text((x, y), title, font=font, fill=(255, 255, 255))

sub = ImageFont.truetype("C:/Windows/Fonts/arial.ttf", 34)
st = "A day by the water"
sb = d.textbbox((0, 0), st, font=sub)
d.text(((W - (sb[2] - sb[0])) // 2 - sb[0], 230 - sb[1]), st, font=sub, fill=(255, 236, 200))

img.save("cover.png")
print("saved", img.size, img.format)

--- run_cycle.py ---
import json
import urllib.error
from bh_api import call

TEXT = "Testing the new Bluehaze uploader: Harbor Day is on."
ALT = "Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026."
COLL = "app.bluehaze.feed.post"

with open("baseline.json", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    base = json.load(fh)
did = base["session"]["did"]

# sanity: cover.png is a real 1200x675 PNG
from PIL import Image
with Image.open("cover.png") as im:
    assert im.size == (1200, 675) and im.format == "PNG", (im.size, im.format)
print("cover.png verified: 1200x675 PNG")

png = open("cover.png", "rb").read()
up = call("com.bluehaze.repo.uploadBlob", body=png, ctype="image/png")
print("uploadBlob:", json.dumps(up))
blob = up["blob"]

import datetime
record = {
    "$type": COLL,
    "text": TEXT,
    "createdAt": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
    "embed": {"$type": "app.bluehaze.embed.images", "images": [{"image": blob, "alt": ALT}]},
}
created = call("com.bluehaze.repo.createRecord", body={"repo": did, "collection": COLL, "record": record})
print("createRecord:", json.dumps(created))
uri = created["uri"]
rkey = uri.split("/")[-1]

# verify live post
thread = call("app.bluehaze.feed.getPostThread", {"uri": uri})
post = thread["thread"]["post"]
assert post["record"]["text"] == TEXT, post["record"]["text"]
imgs = post["embed"]["images"]
assert len(imgs) == 1 and imgs[0]["alt"] == ALT, imgs
assert post["author"]["handle"] == "tester.bluehaze.test"
print("live post verified: exact text, 1 image, exact alt")
print("image src:", imgs[0].get("thumb") or imgs[0].get("fullsize"))

tl = call("app.bluehaze.feed.getTimeline", {"limit": "30"})
assert any(i["post"]["uri"] == uri for i in tl["feed"]), "new post missing from timeline"
print("post visible in timeline; total now:", len(tl["feed"]))

# delete only this post
call("com.bluehaze.repo.deleteRecord", body={"repo": did, "collection": COLL, "rkey": rkey})
print("deleteRecord done for", rkey)

# verify gone
try:
    call("app.bluehaze.feed.getPostThread", {"uri": uri})
    raise SystemExit("FAIL: post still exists after delete")
except RuntimeError as e:
    print("post thread after delete ->", e, "(gone)")

def sig(feed):
    return [(i["post"]["uri"], i["post"]["record"]["text"], i["post"].get("cid")) for i in feed["feed"]]

tl2 = call("app.bluehaze.feed.getTimeline", {"limit": "30"})
af2 = call("app.bluehaze.feed.getAuthorFeed", {"actor": "tester.bluehaze.test", "limit": "30"})
assert sig(tl2) == sig(base["timeline"]), "timeline differs from baseline"
assert sig(af2) == sig(base["author"]), "author feed differs from baseline"
assert not any(i["post"]["uri"] == uri for i in tl2["feed"])
print("final timeline identical to baseline:", len(tl2["feed"]), "posts")
print("final author feed identical to baseline:", len(af2["feed"]), "post(s)")
print("CYCLE OK: posted, verified, deleted; nothing else changed")
